news.title: ScottsMiracle-Gro CEO on Earnings Beat, Growth Outlook

Nate Baxter, the company’s President and CEO, says fiscal 2026 revenue grew about 1%, partly because the company exited lower-margin commodity products and changed its product mix. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Vonnie Quinn on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
